intake.lead: Files you upload in several batches are added to the existing list. Rows that were read become the evidence for an admin review request.
intake.analysis.question: The new files were analyzed and an admin review question was opened.
intake.analysis.matches: The result matches the confirmed rule, so no new question was opened.
intake.sheetsAdded: {n, plural, one {Added # sheet link.} other {Added # sheet links.}} Their contents haven't been read yet.
intake.archiveTitle: Remove this file from the list?
intake.archiveBody: ‘{name}’ will be left out of the file list and future analysis. The original is not deleted; it stays on file as evidence for documents already issued.
intake.archived: Removed. The remaining files were analyzed again.
intake.addLead: Academic calendars, assessment schedules, blank report card or student record forms, and so on. Use synthetic or de-identified data.
intake.fileHint: You can add several files at once or in batches.
intake.readNote: CSV, TSV, TXT, XLSX (each sheet), and DOCX (tables in the document) are read. PDF tables are estimated from text positions, so check the evidence against the original. Scanned PDFs and other formats are stored and left waiting to be read.
intake.sheetNote: Sheet access isn't connected here. Links stay as ‘link only’, and analysis uses attached files. Download the same sheet as XLSX or CSV and attach it.
intake.accuracyTitle: The table was estimated from text positions. Check the evidence rows against the original.
intake.appendNote: New files are added to the existing list. Confirmed rules don't change when new files arrive; if the result differs, a new question is opened.
review.lead: Review what was estimated from the files, with its evidence, and confirm it. Each confirmation adds a new version; earlier versions and issued documents stay as they are.
review.q.differs: New files differ from the confirmed rule
review.q.relation: How terms and assessment periods relate
review.q.sub: {n, plural, one {# evidence row} other {# evidence rows}}
review.q.issues: {n, plural, one { · # point to check} other { · # points to check}}
review.matches: The confirmed rule matches the current files. Uploading more files triggers a new analysis.
review.uploadFirst: Attach an academic calendar or assessment file first.
review.currentMeta: v{v} · confirmed {when} · won't change when files are added later.
review.noRuleYet: No rule has been confirmed yet. Answering this question creates v1.
review.supersededNote: The files changed, so a new question replaced this one. Nothing was confirmed from it.
review.noRulesBody: Answering a pending question creates the first version.
review.ruleMeta: Confirmed {when} · {how} · {n} evidence rows · won't change when files are added later.
review.ruleQuestion: See the question behind this version
review.conflictAlert: New files differ from or conflict with confirmed v{v}. The confirmed values stay as they are until you confirm a new version below.
